actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 393 - 16 (Roll no. 179).
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 393 - 16 (Roll no. 179).
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H3645-3646)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 5317.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H3586-3588; text: CR H3586)
Mr. Hill (AR) moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended.
Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 321.

dimensions.assessment: Applies to insured depository institutions with less than $10 billion in total assets that accept custodial deposits.
dimensions.evidence: insured depository institution that has less than $10,000,000,000 in total assets

dimensions.assessment: Alters regulatory treatment and interest rate restrictions for qualifying community bank deposits.
dimensions.evidence: Custodial deposits of an eligible institution shall not be considered to be funds obtained... through a deposit broker

dimensions.assessment: Reduces the Federal Reserve discretionary surplus fund by $4,000,000 effective September 1, 2036.
dimensions.evidence: The dollar amount specified under section 7(a)(3)(A) of the Federal Reserve Act... is reduced by $4,000,000.

dimensions.assessment: Amends Section 29 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act to create a limited exception and interest rate restrictions for custodial deposits.
dimensions.evidence: Section 29 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (12 U.S.C. 1831f) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent regulatory changes for community bank deposits, alongside a specific reduction taking effect in 2036.
dimensions.evidence: The amendment made by subsection (a) shall take effect on September 1, 2036.

importance_detail.rationale: Changes deposit classification rules for well-capitalized insured depository institutions with under $10 billion in assets, exempting certain custodial deposits from brokered deposit limits up to 20 percent of liabilities, and reduces a Federal Reserve surplus fund by $4 million in 2036.

card.summary: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act establishes and modifies federal housing programs and banking regulations to address housing supply, affordability, and regulatory hurdles. It creates pilot programs and grant initiatives for housing repairs, conversions of empty buildings, small-dollar mortgages, and manufactured housing without permanent chassis. It also adjusts environmental review rules under NEPA, alters bank investment limits, modifies the HOME Investment Partnerships program, and restricts the Federal Reserve from issuing a central bank digital currency.
card.title: 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act
